verses.text: Nadab and Abihu, Aaron's sons, each took his incense pan, put fire in it, and laid incense on it. They offered the LORD a fire that was not allowed, something he had not commanded them to do.
So fire came out from the LORD and burned them up, and they died in front of the LORD.

Then Moses said to Aaron, "This is what the LORD meant when he said, 'I will show that I am holy to those who come near me, and I will be honoured in front of all the people.'" And Aaron said nothing.
Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. He said to them, "Come here and carry your cousins away from the front of the holy place, out of the camp."
So they came and carried them out of the camp, still in their shirts, as Moses had said.

Then Moses said to Aaron and his sons Eleazar and Ithamar, "Do not let your hair hang loose or tear your clothes to mourn, or you will die, and the LORD will be angry with the whole community. But your relatives, all the people of Israel, may weep over those the LORD has burned with fire.
Do not leave the door of the Tent of Meeting, or you will die, because the LORD's anointing oil is on you." So they did what Moses said.
Then the LORD said to Aaron,
"You and your sons must not drink wine or strong drink when you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This is a rule forever, for all your families to come.
You must know the difference between what is holy and what is ordinary, and between what is unclean and what is clean.
And you must teach the people of Israel all the rules the LORD has given them through Moses."

Moses said to Aaron and to Eleazar and Ithamar, his sons who were still alive, "Take the grain offering that is left from the gifts made by fire to the LORD, and eat it without yeast beside the altar, because it is most holy.
Eat it in a holy place, because it is your share and your sons' share of the gifts made by fire to the LORD. This is what I have been commanded.

But you, your sons, and your daughters may eat the breast that was waved and the thigh that was lifted up, in any clean place. They are given to you and your children as your share from the peace offerings of the people of Israel.

The thigh that is lifted up and the breast that is waved must be brought with the fat for the gifts made by fire, and waved in front of the LORD as a wave offering. They will belong to you and your children as your share forever, as the LORD has commanded."
Then Moses searched carefully for the goat of the sin offering, and found that it had been burned up. He was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's sons who were left, and said,
"Why didn't you eat the sin offering in the holy area? It is most holy, and God gave it to you to take away the guilt of the community, to make them right with God in front of the LORD.
Its blood was not brought inside the holy place, so you should have eaten the meat in the holy area, as I commanded."

Aaron answered Moses, "Look, today they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering to the LORD, and yet these terrible things have happened to me. If I had eaten the sin offering today, would the LORD have been pleased?"
When Moses heard this, he was satisfied.
